app.name: TeraBox: 1TB Cloud & AI Space
app.description: A cloud storage app offering up to 1TB of free space for files, photos, and videos, with AI-powered features for photo categorization and audio transcription.

verdict.one_liner: TeraBox gives you 1TB of free storage but scans your files with AI, sends your audio to Google, and builds a behavioral profile of you for automated marketing decisions.
verdict.summary: TeraBox is a cloud storage service that collects extensive data including all files you upload, your contacts, device identifiers, and even your clipboard contents. It uses AI to scan and categorize your photos, sends audio recordings to Google for transcription, and explicitly builds behavioral profiles for automated marketing. While it offers encryption and security features, the breadth of data collection and sharing raises significant privacy concerns.
verdict.recommendation_reason: TeraBox offers generous free storage but at a significant privacy cost. Your files are scanned by AI, your audio is sent to Google, and your behavior is profiled for marketing. Consider alternatives with stronger privacy commitments.

red.title: AI scans all your uploaded photos
red.plain_english: TeraBox uses artificial intelligence to analyze your uploaded photos, identifying faces, locations, scenes, and objects. While they say this is only for organization, your entire photo library is being analyzed by their systems.

red.title: Audio recordings sent to Google
red.plain_english: When you use the transcription or note-taking features, your audio files are sent to Google's servers for processing. This means Google has access to anything you record.

red.title: Builds behavioral profiles for marketing
red.plain_english: TeraBox explicitly creates detailed profiles about your habits, interests, and even creditworthiness from your usage data. These profiles are used to send you personalized marketing messages through automated decisions.

red.title: Reads your clipboard without permission
red.plain_english: TeraBox reads whatever you have copied to your clipboard, including invitation codes, file links, passwords, and redemption codes. While they say they don't read it for other purposes, they have access to anything you copy.

red.title: Uploads and stores your phone contacts
red.plain_english: If you grant permission, TeraBox uploads your phone contacts, email addresses, and social media contacts to their servers to make sharing easier. This sensitive information is stored on their servers.

green.title: Encrypts files at rest
green.plain_english: TeraBox uses encryption to protect your files while they are stored on their servers, and offers two-factor authentication to help keep your account secure.

green.title: Account deletion available in app
green.plain_english: You can delete your TeraBox account directly within the app settings. They promise to delete your data within 30 days of receiving the request.

green.title: Can opt out of marketing emails
green.plain_english: You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link. You can also refuse automated decision-making through app settings or by contacting them.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: You can use the camera to take photos for upload, and record audio for transcription. These are optional features and only active when you choose to use them.
categories.detail: Camera used for photo capture and AI beautification. Audio recorded for transcription sent to Google. No background access mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you enable camera permissions or authorize access to your photo library, please note that uploaded images may contain faces... When you use our transcription or note-taking features, the audio content you choose to upload is sent to our servers for processing.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: TeraBox may collect your location information depending on your device settings, particularly when you access the service or upload photos with location metadata.
categories.detail: Location information collected depending on device settings. Photo metadata may include geographic locations.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information... may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, identifiers tied to the device, and location information depending on the device settings.
concerns: Location collected based on device settings

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: TeraBox can access your phone contacts, email addresses, and social media contacts to help you share files. They store this contact information on their servers.
categories.detail: Contacts access is optional but stored on server if granted. Includes phone contacts, emails, Facebook and Twitter contacts.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can choose to allow TeraBox to access your contact information to facilitate certain operations... We store this information on our server for you to use.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: As a cloud storage app, TeraBox stores all files you upload. They also offer an optional AI feature that scans your photos to organize them by people, places, and objects.
categories.detail: All uploaded user data stored on servers. Optional Smart Photo Categorization scans uploaded photos for faces, locations, scenes, and objects.
categories.policy_excerpt: User data: It is data that you store on TeraBox, such as files, documents, photos, videos, and audio... we provide smart classification services based on User Data (including automated clustering of photos based on people, scenes, and geographic locations).

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: TeraBox shares your data with Google for audio transcription, third-party service providers, and other companies under the same corporate group. They also share with other users when you use team or share features.
categories.detail: Shared with Google (audio processing), third-party rendering providers, Flextech affiliates, other users via Teamwork/Share, and service providers. Cross-border data transfers mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: To provide transcription and note generation services, your audio content is transmitted to Google, our third-party AI service provider, for processing. We may share infrastructure, systems, and technology with Flextech affiliates... We may work with certain trusted third parties (such as customer support or IT service providers).

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox collects your email, phone number, and social media profile data for your account. For some features, they require your real name, government ID number, and even facial recognition verification.
categories.detail: Account requires email/phone/SNS login. Some services require real name, identity document number, and facial recognition for authentication.
categories.policy_excerpt: In the event that it is required by laws and regulations... you must provide your real name, identity document number, and facial recognition information for account authentication... we may compare the real-name information you provide to Terabox with that registered at institutions permitted by laws and regulations or authorized by government agencies.
concerns: Facial recognition required for some features

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: TeraBox tracks everything you do in the app and builds a detailed profile of your habits and interests. They use this profile to send you personalized marketing messages through automated decisions.
categories.detail: Explicit creation of label information reflecting operation habits, interests, and credit. Used for automated decision-making and personalized/marketing information. Also tracks search queries, usage info, and cookies.
categories.policy_excerpt: We can aggregate, integrate, identify, analyze, portray, or further process the personal information... to form a variety of label information with different degrees of granularity that reflect your operation habits, interests, or credit... We will use label information for automated decision-making in specific scenarios and applications, so as to send you personalized information and/or marketing information.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: TeraBox says users should be at least 13 years old, but their terms say you must be 15. This inconsistency is confusing. They say they will remove data on children under 13 if discovered.
categories.detail: Privacy policy says 13+ (or local age of majority). Terms say 15+. No knowingly collecting from children under 13.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from children under the age of 13... You must be at least 15 years old (or older, depending on where you live) to use the Services.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: TeraBox collects your IP address and even tracks which websites you visited right before opening TeraBox. They also log every action you take in the app, like creating, editing, and moving files.
categories.detail: Collects IP address, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, and all usage operations (editing, viewing, creating, moving files).
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information: This refers to information about the device used to access the Services and may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox... Usage information: It is information about how the Services are used, including operations performed in your account such as editing, viewing, creating, and moving files or folders.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: TeraBox collects detailed information about your device, including unique identifiers tied to your device, your browser type, and your operating system. This helps them track and identify your device.
categories.detail: Collects device identifiers, browser info, OS, and IP. Used to optimize and protect services.
categories.policy_excerpt: Device information: This refers to information about the device used to access the Services and may include IP address, browser, and device information, web pages visited prior to accessing TeraBox, identifiers tied to the device...

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox collects your facial recognition information for account verification on some services. Their optional Smart Album feature also uses facial analysis to group your photos by people.
categories.detail: Facial recognition collected for account authentication. Smart Photo Categorization identifies portraits in photos. Claims not to store facial biometric information.
categories.policy_excerpt: you must provide your real name, identity document number, and facial recognition information for account authentication... We do not collect or store any users' facial biometric information.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: TeraBox offers paid subscriptions for extra features and storage. Payments are processed through Apple or Google's app stores, so TeraBox does not directly handle your credit card.
categories.detail: In-app purchases processed through Software Store (Apple/Google). Website payments through unspecified gateway.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you make an in-app purchase, you will be prompted to enter details for your account with your Software Store.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account in the app settings, and TeraBox promises to delete your data within 30 days. However, they may refuse if you have unused Premium benefits, and they may keep some data for legal reasons.
categories.detail: Account deletion available in app. May take 30 days. May refuse if unused Premium benefits or account data exists. May retain for legal obligations. Backup deletion delayed. Data export/copy rights available.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you want to delete your account, please send an email to helpdesk@terabox.com with such a request and we will delete your account within 30 days after receiving your request. However, 1) we will not delete your account information until we have verified your user identity; 2) such deletion of information from our servers and backup storage may be delayed; 3) we may retain this information if necessary to fulfill our legal obligations.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: TeraBox can change its privacy policy at any time and will post the new version on its website. They say they will notify you if changes materially affect your rights, but continued use means you accept the changes.
categories.detail: Releases latest version on website. Notifies if revision materially affects rights. Business transfer notification mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: This Privacy Policy may be modified from time to time. We will release the latest version of it on TeraBox's website if a revision is made. We will notify you if any such revision materially affects your rights.
